note: This Unit's scheduled-compute mechanism (deferred since Contract Design's Open Questions) is resolved at this stage: EventBridge Scheduler with per-Reminder one-time schedules (Q1) for the deliver-push/auto-clear paths, keyed by Reminder.id (no Scan/GSI needed there). The Contract 8 event handler's own lookup is a genuinely different access pattern (by postId, one-to-many) and DOES need a new GSI on postId — this was initially glossed over as if EventBridge Scheduler eliminated all DynamoDB access-pattern design work, corrected at this stage's review (R-02) to design that GSI explicitly rather than repeat suggestion-unit's Query/Scan mistake in a new form. BR7.3's re-snooze-of-an-already-SNOOZED-Reminder ambiguity (disclosed at NFR Requirements, R-05) is also resolved here (functional-design/rules.md and functional-spec.md both amended) as an idempotent no-op gated behind the ownership check — a same-pass ordering bug in that fix (R-01) was caught and corrected before this receipt, and a further gap (a mutation retry not re-syncing the schedule on its own no-op branches) was caught and corrected at R-02/R-03/R-04. Post-gate, the builder made an explicit simplicity choice: BR7.8 (reschedule on Post dateTime change) is now a no-op — a date change surfaces as an additional Reminder on the device's next sync (BR7.1, widened) instead of an in-place reschedule, narrowing the Contract 8 handler's GSI-backed lookup to BR7.9 (PostDeleted) alone.
